skill.description: Guidance for designing, implementing, reviewing, and testing Cloudflare Durable Objects for stateful Workers applications.
skill.summary: Build reliable Cloudflare Durable Objects with patterns for storage, concurrency, RPC, alarms, Workers, and Vitest.
skill.author: cloudflare

security_audit.summary: All 93 static findings are false positives caused by documentation syntax, Durable Objects SQLite APIs, test fixtures, and Cloudflare documentation links. No command execution, local secret access, or data-exfiltration behavior was found. One medium-risk documentation issue remains: the CORS example uses a wildcard origin while allowing Authorization.

remediation.issue: The CORS example permits every origin and the Authorization header.
remediation.suggestion: Require an allowlist of trusted origins for authenticated APIs, validate the Origin header, and add Vary: Origin to responses.

semantic_findings.title: Overly Broad CORS Example
semantic_findings.description: The CORS example permits every origin while allowing the Authorization header. Users who copy it for authenticated endpoints may expose those endpoints to untrusted origins.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The example explicitly sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin to a wildcard and permits Authorization. This is a well-known unsafe default for authenticated browser APIs.

content.value_statement: Stateful Workers applications can fail when storage, concurrency, and routing patterns are unclear. This skill provides practical Durable Objects patterns for implementation, review, configuration, and testing.
actual_capabilities: Design Durable Object boundaries for rooms, users, games, and tenants.
Create TypeScript patterns for SQLite storage, RPC methods, alarms, and WebSockets.
Review Durable Object code for routing, persistence, concurrency, and atomicity concerns.
Configure Durable Object bindings and SQLite migrations in Wrangler files.
Create unit and integration tests with @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers.
Retrieve current Cloudflare documentation before implementing API-dependent features.
limitations: It does not deploy Workers or change Cloudflare account settings.
It cannot replace project-specific authorization, data-retention, or privacy design.
Examples require adaptation to the application schema and compatibility date.
It does not guarantee that referenced Cloudflare APIs remain unchanged.

use_cases.title: Plan coordinated application state
use_cases.description: Design room, game, booking, or tenant objects with clear ownership and routing.

use_cases.title: Review Durable Object code
use_cases.description: Check storage, concurrency, RPC, alarms, and error handling before release.

use_cases.title: Build Workers test coverage
use_cases.description: Create isolated Vitest tests for Durable Object methods, HTTP routes, storage, and alarms.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Durable Object
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a TypeScript Durable Object for a chat room. Include a Wrangler binding, SQLite schema, and two RPC methods.

prompt_templates.title: Add reliable storage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Durable Object storage design. Recommend a SQLite schema and explain how to keep related writes atomic.

prompt_templates.title: Test an alarm workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a Vitest test plan for a Durable Object alarm that expires booking holds. Include normal, retry, and isolation cases.

prompt_templates.title: Review a production design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Workers and Durable Objects architecture for sharding, authorization boundaries, concurrency, WebSocket lifecycle, and observability. List prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: Design a booking Durable Object with temporary holds.
output: Suggested one object per resource or schedule.
SQLite tables for holds and confirmed bookings.
An alarm pattern for hold expiration.

output_examples.input: Review my Durable Object test strategy.
output: Coverage gaps for isolated storage and alarm execution.
Recommended direct object and HTTP integration tests.
Concrete assertions for routing and persistence.

best_practices: Retrieve current Cloudflare documentation before relying on an API or configuration detail.
Persist critical state before updating in-memory caches.
Use a trusted-origin allowlist for authenticated CORS endpoints.
anti_patterns: Do not route all requests through one global Durable Object.
Do not hold blockConcurrencyWhile across network or other external I/O.
Do not store secrets in Wrangler configuration files.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build and review Cloudflare Durable Objects for stateful Workers applications.

faq.question: Can it create Durable Object code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose TypeScript classes, Workers handlers, Wrangler configuration, and tests.

faq.question: Does it support SQLite storage?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for SQLite schemas, parameterized queries, and migrations.

faq.question: Can it help with testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers unit tests, HTTP integration tests, storage inspection, and alarm tests with Vitest.

faq.question: Does it deploy my Worker?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples but does not deploy or modify Cloudflare resources.

faq.question: Should I use the CORS example unchanged?
faq.answer: No. Replace wildcard origins with a trusted-origin allowlist for authenticated APIs.
